name: lopsy
description: Lopsy: a browser-based image editor (apps/lopsy-web), Lopsy Photos (apps/lopsy-photos, proof of concept) and the engine they render with (engine)

scripts.build:site: VITE_PHOTOS_URL=/photos/ npm run build && npm run build:photos:site && npm run assemble:site
scripts.build:site:noopt: npm run wasm:build:noopt && VITE_PHOTOS_URL=/photos/ npm run build:lopsy:app && npm run build:photos:site && npm run assemble:site
scripts.test:photos: npm run test -w @lopsy/photos-core && npm run test -w lopsy-photos
scripts.test:e2e:site: npm exec -w lopsy-photos -- playwright test -c playwright.site.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:offline: npm run build:photos:site && node scripts/assemble-site.mjs --photos-only --out dist/photos-site && (npm exec -w lopsy-photos -- playwright test -c playwright.offline.config.ts; status=$?; rm -rf dist/photos-site apps/lopsy-photos/dist; exit $status)
scripts.typecheck:photos: npm run typecheck -w @lopsy/photos-core && npm run typecheck -w lopsy-photos
scripts.lint:photos: npm run lint -w @lopsy/photos-core && npm run lint -w lopsy-photos
